combined_decision: Retain prores_ks XQ at 8192 bits/MB for normal QuickTime delivery. VideoToolbox ranks first on uniform NPS but has substantially larger T020 RGB/OKLab error and slight high-pass overshoot; its statistical retention is not pixel fidelity. Maximum-budget prores_ks improves both real-scene and uniform-NPS accuracy over default XQ without overshoot. FFV1 remains the exact lossless research control.
decision_rule: Prefer the QuickTime-compatible ProRes candidate with the lowest formed-minus-mean band error, provided it does not create a larger total-RMS error. FFV1 is the exact lossless control.
